attributes.law_screen: Full core-screen set fetched via `laws --tag core-screen --full 1` before the first edit. APPLIED: claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web.20260830.v1 - the governing law for the whole pass; every conversion kept the site's ORIGINAL base pointer and its declared type (u8*), and respelled only the integer displacement as offsetof(...) or a documented macro, so the front end still sees one additive expression. APPLIED as exclusion: claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction.20260831.v1 - the walked strides 13148 (Player), 108 (LookoutParam), 104 (MilestoneParam) and 916 (Enemy pool) were deliberately LEFT as bare literals rather than respelled sizeof(T), and that decision is now commented in-source at the fn_80046680 loop. APPLIED as exclusion: claim.law.offsetof-fused-immediate-counter.20260830.v1 and claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression.20260830.v1 - no walked pointer was converted to array-of-struct indexing anywhere; the milestone matrix[12..14] reads in move_logic22 are the exact shape the fused-immediate law recorded regressing (items.c update_player_milestone real 46 -> 89), so they got named constants, not a struct view. APPLIED: claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast.20260830.v1 and claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing.20260830.v2 - no typed alias was introduced at any multi-field base, in particular not on the move_logic12/13 flee blocks, which read 5-6 nearby Enemy fields off one index-computed base (the v2 law's recorded regression shape, real 0 -> 83 on move_logic05). SCREENED, NOT TRIGGERED: lwzu-idiom-web-retention (the `*(s32*)(e0 += ENEMY_POOL_OFF)` fused sites were respelled but never retyped, which is precisely what the preserves-protected-web law permits), swap-loop-is-record-layout-ground-truth, dead-offset-shadow-removal-*, recomputed-index-array-form-safe, scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form, embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade (no header modified), local-alias-vs-direct-global-spelling-diverges (no global spelling changed).

This is the failure mode AGENTS.md warns about - grep include/game/*.h FIRST; a lookup failure is not a knowledge gap.
